positions.title: Communications Specialist (911 dispatcher)
positions.notes: Entry-level/posted pay from a current job posting (not a full range or actual salaries). Posting opened 2026-09-21 (job 5437988): entry level incl. $500 retention/longevity; 12-hour rotating shifts. Earlier announcements: $42,000 (Aug 6, 2025) and $49,741 (Nov 25, 2025). Hourly = annual / 2,080 (derived).

department_totals.department: Sheriff's Office (law enforcement) - funded via BOCC
department_totals.notes: FY2027 BOCC budget transfers to the Sheriff (cost center 0120): $40,011,318 general + $2,272,842 school resource officers + $2,929,029 Callaway + $1,369,578 Mexico Beach + smaller items. Not a personnel breakdown.
FY2027 BOCC budget cost center 0121: $30,019,589 Fees & Cost-Sheriff/Jail + $987,673 inmate welfare.

gaps: Sheriff's FY2026-27 budget submission (s. 30.49, F.S.) with personnel services detail (positions by rank, salaries, overtime, FRS, health) is not posted on bayso.org or baycountyfl.gov. Request from BCSO Finance/Personnel: 'FY2026-27 budget as submitted to the BOCC under s. 30.49 F.S., including position/rank counts and Personal Services detail'.

No published BCSO pay plan / step plan by rank (deputy, corporal, sergeant, lieutenant, captain, major; detention ranks; communications). Request: 'current BCSO pay plan/salary schedule for sworn, detention and civilian classifications'.
No PBA/FOP or other collective bargaining agreement for BCSO found online. Verify with Florida PERC whether a BCSO bargaining unit exists and request any current CBA.
Salaries for the Undersheriff/Chief Deputy and Majors are not published.
Positions here are job-posting entry rates only (source_type 'job posting'), not ranges or actual salaries.
